lead_raw_text:
The structure of composition K4V4O8 (reduced formula KV2O4) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/m (No. 12), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies vanadium centers in tetrahedral environments with four oxygen neighbors, while potassium centers show eight geometric neighbors (four K and four O). The vanadium tetrahedra share corners, and corner-sharing also links vanadium tetrahedra with both potassium and oxygen coordination polyhedra. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 16 sites.
